CODE_84:E641.timer: decrement $16; return when nonzero; otherwise select next item

CODE_84:E683.timer: decrement $16; return when nonzero; otherwise reuse $18 selection

selection.direction_index: $2E shifted left selects a word from the table pointed by $1C
selection.cursor: $1A selects a word from the resulting sequence
selection.duration: low byte of selected control word is written to $16
selection.descriptor: selected word is normalized and passed in X to CODE_84:E6C7
selection.sign_path: negative selected word increments $1A by two before queueing; nonnegative clears $1A

limitations: A, Y, $1A, $1C, and $2E are native control values; this artifact does not name them as a particular player action.
The meaning of CODE_84:E58F and the high bits of sequence words is not fully decoded.
Queueing a descriptor does not by itself prove its final OAM, CGRAM palette, or pixels without a matching runtime frame.
